title: Simultaneously compatible exact boundaries on actual restricted cohomology groups
statement: Let I be a preorder, D:I^op → Sch [def-pc-scheme] a diagram with cone c [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], and F_i abelian étale sheaves [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. For f:i→j let φ_f:D(f^op)^*F_i→F_j be arbitrary coefficient morphisms [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Let G:I→Ab(c.pt_et) have specified isomorphisms eG_i:G_i≅c_i^*F_i, and L a cocone on G. Fix X, opens U,V [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], q≥0, i₀∈I and g₀:D_i₀→X. Put J=I_{≥i₀}, g_j=D(j→i₀);g₀ and g_L=c_i₀;g₀. For W an open of X write W_j=g_j^{-1}W, W_L=g_L^{-1}W, A_W(j)=H^q(W_j,F_j|), A_W(L)=H^q(W_L,L.pt|) [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]. Denote by T_W(f) and λ_W(j) the actual canonical restricted cohomology maps of tailOpenCohomologyMapDegree and tailOpenCohomologyLegDegree [lem-weil-pbc-etale-limit-open-cohomology-cocone-degree]: restricted pullback followed by the coefficient morphism obtained using inverse-image composition comparisons from φ_f or (eG_j)^-1;L_j, respectively [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback]. Define d_j:A_U(j)×A_V(j)→A_{U∩V}(j) by d_j(x,y)=res_{U∩V,U}(x)-res_{U∩V,V}(y), with restrictions openCohomologyRestriction along the inverse-image inclusions; define d_L by the identical formula at g_L with coefficient L.pt. No identity/composition laws on φ or canonical-arrow formula for G are assumed. Assume U_j∪V_j=D_j for each j and U_L∪V_L=c.pt. There are additive maps δ_j:A_{U∩V}(j)→H^{q+1}(D_j,F_j) and δ_L:A_{U∩V}(L)→H^{q+1}(c.pt,L.pt), such that Exact(d_j,δ_j), Exact(δ_j,(res_U,res_V)) for every j and Exact(d_L,δ_L). They satisfy δ_k T_{U∩V}(f)=H^{q+1}(φ_f)D(f^op)^*δ_j for every f:j→k and δ_L λ_{U∩V}(j)=H^{q+1}((eG_j)^-1;L_j)c_j^*δ_j for every j. This supplies neither a natural difference transformation nor any transported KU, KV, KI, H, cocone legs, or restriction row r. In Lean the additive differences d_j and d_L are supplied with their exact pointwise restriction formulas, so they are uniquely the displayed actual differences, rather than independently chosen maps.

source.place: Tag 0A50, proof and coefficient functoriality; Tag 09YQ, coherent-system restriction maps. Read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0A50 and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/09YQ; the compatibility extension is agent-written.

proof.text: Define every stage and limit boundary by the irreducible fixed-boundary interface, using the inverse-image intersection equality. This interface fixes resolutions and normalized comparisons before any arrow is considered.

Apply fixed-boundary exactness at each stage and at the limit, feeding the given pointwise difference formulas hd and hdL as function equalities. This proves the three exactness conjuncts, with no need to compare algebraic structures on a supplied difference map.

For a stage arrow, functoriality of D identifies the target opens with the inverse images of the source opens. Specialize fixed-boundary naturality to the underlying scheme map, its restricted intersection map tailStageOpenMap and phi. Unfold only the canonical restricted cohomology arrow to identify its openSquareCoefficient formula.

For each cone leg, the cone equation identifies the limit opens with the inverse images of the stage opens. Specialize the same fixed-boundary naturality to c_j, tailLimitOpenMap and (eG_j).inv followed by L.ι_j. The canonical cohomology-leg formula gives the required equality. The same fixed boundaries are used for every arrow and leg.

theorem tailOpenCompatibleBoundaries
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (U V : X.Opens)
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I]
    (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u}) (c : Cone D)
    (F : ∀ i : I, Sheaf (D.obj (op i)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (φ : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j),
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map f.op)).obj (F i) ⟶ F j)
    (G : I ⥤ Sheaf c.pt.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (eG : ∀ i : I, G.obj i ≅
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op i))).obj (F i))
    (L : Cocone G) (q : ℕ) (i₀ : I) (g₀ : D.obj (op i₀) ⟶ X)
    (d : ∀ j : Set.Ici i₀,
      (Sheaf.H ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (tailStageOpen D g₀ U j).ι).obj
        (F j.val)) q ×
       Sheaf.H ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (tailStageOpen D g₀ V j).ι).obj
        (F j.val)) q) →+
      Sheaf.H ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (tailStageOpen D g₀ (U ⊓ V) j).ι).obj
        (F j.val)) q)
    (dL : (Sheaf.H ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
        ((c.π.app (op i₀) ≫ g₀) ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).obj L.pt) q ×
      Sheaf.H ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
        ((c.π.app (op i₀) ≫ g₀) ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι).obj L.pt) q) →+
      Sheaf.H ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
        ((c.π.app (op i₀) ≫ g₀) ⁻¹ᵁ (U ⊓ V)).ι).obj L.pt) q)
    (hd : (∀ j x, d j x =
      openCohomologyRestriction (X := D.obj (op j.val))
        (A := tailStageOpen D g₀ (U ⊓ V) j) (B := tailStageOpen D g₀ U j)
        ((D.map (homOfLE j.property).op ≫ g₀).preimage_mono
          (inf_le_left : U ⊓ V ≤ U)) (F j.val) q x.1 -
      openCohomologyRestriction (X := D.obj (op j.val))
        (A := tailStageOpen D g₀ (U ⊓ V) j) (B := tailStageOpen D g₀ V j)
        ((D.map (homOfLE j.property).op ≫ g₀).preimage_mono
          (inf_le_right : U ⊓ V ≤ V)) (F j.val) q x.2))
    (hdL : (∀ x, dL x =
      openCohomologyRestriction (X := c.pt)
        (A := (c.π.app (op i₀) ≫ g₀) ⁻¹ᵁ (U ⊓ V))
        (B := (c.π.app (op i₀) ≫ g₀) ⁻¹ᵁ U)
        ((c.π.app (op i₀) ≫ g₀).preimage_mono (inf_le_left : U ⊓ V ≤ U)) L.pt q x.1 -
      openCohomologyRestriction (X := c.pt)
        (A := (c.π.app (op i₀) ≫ g₀) ⁻¹ᵁ (U ⊓ V))
        (B := (c.π.app (op i₀) ≫ g₀) ⁻¹ᵁ V)
        ((c.π.app (op i₀) ≫ g₀).preimage_mono (inf_le_right : U ⊓ V ≤ V)) L.pt q x.2))
    (hstageCover : ∀ j : Set.Ici i₀,
      tailStageOpen D (X := X) (i₀ := i₀) g₀ U j ⊔ tailStageOpen D (X := X) (i₀ := i₀) g₀ V j = ⊤)
    (hlimitCover : ((c.π.app (op i₀) ≫ g₀) ⁻¹ᵁ U) ⊔
      ((c.π.app (op i₀) ≫ g₀) ⁻¹ᵁ V) = ⊤) :
    ∃ (δ : ∀ j : Set.Ici i₀, Sheaf.H
        ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (tailStageOpen D (X := X) (i₀ := i₀) g₀ (U ⊓ V) j).ι).obj
          (F j.val)) q →+ Sheaf.H (F j.val) (q + 1))
      (δL : Sheaf.H ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
        ((c.π.app (op i₀) ≫ g₀) ⁻¹ᵁ (U ⊓ V)).ι).obj L.pt) q →+
          Sheaf.H L.pt (q + 1)),
      (∀ j, Function.Exact (d j) (δ j)) ∧
      (∀ j, Function.Exact (δ j) (fun x ↦
        (cohomologyMap (tailStageOpen D (X := X) (i₀ := i₀) g₀ U j).ι (F j.val) (q + 1) x,
          cohomologyMap (tailStageOpen D (X := X) (i₀ := i₀) g₀ V j).ι (F j.val) (q + 1) x))) ∧
      Function.Exact dL δL ∧
      (∀ (j k : Set.Ici i₀) (f : j ⟶ k)
        (x : Sheaf.H ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
          (tailStageOpen D (X := X) (i₀ := i₀) g₀ (U ⊓ V) j).ι).obj (F j.val)) q),
        δ k ((tailOpenCohomologyMapDegree D (X := X) (i₀ := i₀) g₀ (U ⊓ V) F φ q f).hom x) =
        Sheaf.H.map (φ (homOfLE (show j.val ≤ k.val from f.le))) (q + 1)
          (cohomologyMap (D.map (homOfLE (show j.val ≤ k.val from f.le)).op)
            (F j.val) (q + 1) (δ j x))) ∧
      (∀ (j : Set.Ici i₀)
        (x : Sheaf.H ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
          (tailStageOpen D (X := X) (i₀ := i₀) g₀ (U ⊓ V) j).ι).obj (F j.val)) q),
        δL ((tailOpenCohomologyLegDegree D c (X := X) (i₀ := i₀) g₀ (U ⊓ V) F G eG L q j).hom x) =
        Sheaf.H.map ((eG j.val).inv ≫ L.ι.app j.val) (q + 1)
          (cohomologyMap (c.π.app (op j.val)) (F j.val) (q + 1) (δ j x)))
